On a night defined by high stakes and tactical maneuvering, Neom SC and Al Hazm faced off in a fixture where momentum swung like a pendulum. Both teams entered the contest desperate to assert their authority, setting the stage for a physical encounter that would eventually be decided by a mixture of clinical finishing and a moment of heartbreak from twelve yards. Benrahma Ignites the Match The encounter, played on April 28, 2026 , burst into life almost immediately as the home side sought to capitalize on their early pressure. Within just seven minutes, the deadlock was broken through a moment of pure quality. Amadou Kone turned provider, carving out an opening with a precise delivery that found Said Benrahma . The Algerian international made no mistake, firing his effort past the goalkeeper to give Neom SC a dream start and send the home crowd into raptures. For much of the opening period, Neom SC looked the more likely to double their advantage, controlling the tempo and forcing Al Hazm into a defensive shell. The visitors struggled to retain possession in the middle of the park, often resorting to long balls that were easily dealt with by the Neom SC backline. However, as the clock ticked toward the interval, the game took a dramatic turn that would haunt the hosts for the remainder of the evening. Penalty Heartbreak at the Stroke of Half-Time Deep into first-half stoppage time, Neom SC were handed a golden opportunity to take a commanding lead. After a foul in the area, the referee pointed to the spot, leaving the responsibility to the veteran marksman Alexandre Lacazette . In the 48th minute (45+3'), the former Lyon striker stepped up with the chance to effectively put the game out of reach. However, his effort failed to find the back of the net, providing Al Hazm with a vital lifeline heading into the locker rooms. The second half saw a shift in intensity, with Al Hazm emerging from the break with renewed vigor. The game became increasingly physical, as evidenced by Nathan Zeze receiving a yellow card in the 51st minute. The visitors began to find gaps in the Neom SC midfield, using the energy of their substitutes and the vision of Loreintz Rosier to turn the tide of the contest. Al Hazm Claw Their Way Back The pressure finally told in the 58th minute. Loreintz Rosier showcased his playmaking ability, sliding a perfectly weighted pass through to Abdullah Al-Shanqiti . The finish was composed and clinical, pulling Al Hazm level and completely altering the complexion of the match. The equalizer sparked a period of frantic activity, as both managers turned to their benches to find a winning formula. Neom SC introduced Luciano Rodriguez and later Ahmed Al Anazi , while Al Hazm fortified their defensive lines with Miguel Carvalho . As the match entered its final stages, the referee was kept busy, brandishing yellow cards to Abdulrahman Al Khaibary , Abdulmalik Al Oyayari , and Ahmed Al-Shamrani as the battle for the ball grew more desperate. Despite late substitutions that saw Amadou Bamba Dieng and Sultan Tanker enter the fray for Neom SC , the breakthrough remained elusive. The final whistle blew after five minutes of added time, leaving Neom SC to reflect on a missed opportunity while Al Hazm celebrated a resilient away performance.

As the match entered its final stages, the tension boiled over, resulting in yellow cards for Khalifah Aldawsari and later Abdulaziz Al-Othman deep in stoppage time.
